title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Punta Buri, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Punta Buri National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Punta Buri, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Punta Buri National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Punta Buri, Thị trấn Ajuy, Tỉnh Iloilo được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Punta Buri
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Punta Buri, เทศบาล Ajuy, จังหวัด Iloilo ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Punta Buri
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Punta Buri, Kotamadya Ajuy, Provinsi Iloilo dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Punta Buri
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Punta Buri, Perbandaran Ajuy, Wilayah Iloilo dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Punta Buri

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Punta Buri, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Punta Buri National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
